name: Huraan
summary: Huraan is a mysterious traveler staying within the tavern at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He seeks the aid of Alliance adventurers to recover a valuable shipment of stolen crystals seized by the nearby Forsaken.

sections.title: A Foreign Guest in Southshore
sections.body: Amid the worried human townsfolk and weary soldiers stationed in Southshore, Huraan cuts an unusual figure within the town's inn. Rather than concerning himself with the regional border skirmishes or the local syndicate brigands, his focus is trained squarely on a specific cargo: a cache of precious crystals that fell into the hands of the Forsaken. Determined to recover what was taken, he turns to capable travelers willing to venture near enemy territory to reclaim the lost stones.

faq.answer: Huraan stays inside the inn in Southshore, the Alliance's primary coastal port and stronghold in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Huraan seeks the recovery of a shipment of crystals that was stolen by the Forsaken operating out of the Hillsbrad region.
The crystals were intercepted and stolen by the Forsaken, the undead faction based to the north in Tarren Mill and the ruins of Lordaeron.

angles.text: For Alliance champions based in Southshore, aiding Huraan provides another crucial opportunity to strike back against Forsaken operations in Hillsbrad.
